2607.21437.title: Agent-Guided Relational Concept Discovery: Toward Interpretable Surgical Margin Assessment
2607.21437.paper_summary: Deep learning models can effectively use Rapid Evaporative Ionization Mass Spectrometry (REIMS) data for surgical margin assessment. However, their clinical adoption remains challenging due to limited generalization to operating room conditions. This difficulty arises because models are typically trained on labeled spectra collected from resected tissue samples, while they must operate on noisy, unlabeled data acquired directly during surgery. In addition, the black-box nature of deep learning models makes it difficult to understand and systematically improve their behavior. Concept-based learning offers a promising way to address these challenges by mapping raw measurements to human-understandable concepts. However, supervised concept-based approaches rely on concept annotations, which are difficult to obtain in complex mass spectrometry workflows. We propose Agent-Guided Concept Discovery, a framework that learns meaningful concepts directly from data without requiring predefined concept labels. During training, a reasoning agent refines semantic descriptions of the learned concepts and adaptively adjusts their weight based on diagnostic relevance. These concepts are further grounded using a biochemical knowledge graph to ensure consistency with known metabolic relationships. Across Skin and Breast Cancer datasets, our model improves balanced accuracy and sensitivity over the baseline. In a representative intraoperative case, it shows fewer false positives, indicating better generalization to surgical conditions.
2607.21437.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習模型可以有效利用快速蒸發離子化質譜（REIMS）數據進行手術邊緣評估。<lb/>然而，由於對手術室條件的有限泛化，它們的臨床採用仍然面臨挑戰。<lb/>這一困難的產生是因為模型通常是在從切除的組織樣本中收集的標記光譜上進行訓練，而它們必須在手術過程中直接獲取的嘈雜、未標記數據上運行。<lb/>此外，深度學習模型的黑箱特性使得理解和系統性改善其行為變得困難。<lb/>基於概念的學習提供了一種有前景的方法來解決這些挑戰，通過將原始測量映射到人類可理解的概念。<lb/>然而，監督式的基於概念的方法依賴於概念註釋，而這在複雜的質譜工作流程中難以獲得。<lb/>我們提出了代理引導概念發現，一種直接從數據中學習有意義概念的框架，而不需要預定義的概念標籤。<lb/>在訓練過程中，一個推理代理會細化學習概念的語義描述，並根據診斷相關性自適應地調整其權重。<lb/>這些概念進一步使用生化知識圖進行基礎化，以確保與已知的代謝關係的一致性。<lb/>在皮膚癌和乳腺癌數據集中，我們的模型在平衡準確性和敏感性上超過了基線。<lb/>在一個具有代表性的術中案例中，它顯示出較少的假陽性，表明對手術條件的更好泛化。
